fusions.name: Plague Rain
fusions.desc: Looses a cloud of 6 driving raindrops, spread apart, each dealing 8 damage and ignoring resistances. 15% of the damage it deals comes back to you as healing over the following 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Strip the Stalk
fusions.desc: A jet of water deals 18 damage to the first enemy it meets, using up every affliction you have on it and dealing 60% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Devouring Squall
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a stinging squall for 10 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Stripped Fields
fusions.desc: Every kill builds a stack on you, up to 3. At 3 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (15% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
